title: A free Space can buy Business, Collective or Network yearly from its billing page, at the two-months-free price /pricing advertises

source.ref: Full scan 2026-10-19 (/mnt/project-files/scan/2026-10-19-full-scan, pricing pass P1: every in-app plan button is monthly only). Owner ruling 2026-10-19: make sure the plan works and all pricing aligns.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-19. PREMISE RE-TESTED: createSpaceLoadoutCheckout and startSpaceLoadoutCheckout accepted interval 'year' and the catalog sync holds a yearly Stripe price per item, but ChoosePlanButton and GoBusinessCta both sent interval: 'month', so the yearly deal on /pricing (two months free, ANNUAL_MONTHS_FREE) could not be bought in the product. Fix: a Monthly / Yearly radiogroup (interval-switch.tsx) on the plan ladder and on the Go Business card; the ladder's rows moved to a client island (plan-ladder-rungs.tsx) that holds the choice, while plan-ladder.tsx keeps resolving both intervals' prices and Founding notes on the server through spacePlanPriceCents and yearlyFromMonthly; the seat line on Go Business reads the catalog's yearly seat price. No new price, flag or migration.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d='app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/billing/';const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(d+f)?fs.readFileSync(d+f,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];for(const f of ['choose-plan.tsx','go-business.tsx']){const s=r(f);if(!s)miss.push(f+' missing');if(/interval:\\s*'month'/.test(s))miss.push(f+' still hardcodes monthly');if(!/startSpaceLoadoutCheckout\\(slug, \\{[^}]*\\binterval\\b/.test(s))miss.push(f+' does not pass the chosen interval')}if(!/role=\"radiogroup\"/.test(r('interval-switch.tsx')))miss.push('no Monthly / Yearly switch');if(!/BillingIntervalSwitch/.test(r('plan-ladder-rungs.tsx')))miss.push('the ladder has no switch');if(!/BillingIntervalSwitch/.test(r('go-business.tsx')))miss.push('Go Business has no switch');if(!/yearlyFromMonthly/.test(r('plan-ladder.tsx')))miss.push('the ladder has no yearly price');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-990: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
